title: Stored armor plate sold where it lies, at Node Beta, into the station's plate bid
note: Node Beta's armor-plate bid stood at 380 x 3 at 11:43 UTC and 361 x 4 at 12:44 UTC (ledger.py prices armor_plate); one hauler stores 3 plates there (data/stock/storage.json, 12:21 UTC), made from carapace (game/fleet/plate.py). Floor 300 cr. Written by Apollo, 2026-11-16 13:00 UTC (orders.log ENT-014, block APOLLO (1): sell the stored soma where it lies as the pools refill). Uses the circuit runner's withdraw step (Zero, commit 6f643ec): at a stop that also sells the item it withdraws only what the bid takes at its best price, so nothing withdrawn stays aboard. requires.stored sends only a pilot whose own storage there holds the good; requires.bid closes the route while a book read within the hour shows the bid gone or under its floor. Nothing is bought; a run that finds the bid gone costs the hop's fuel (about 26 cr a jump). A test: one ship until its first RESULT line.
